title: Liberating Distributed Consensus - Heidi Howard
summary: Heidi Howard's Reactive Summit 2018 talk on generalizing Paxos by weakening its original requirements. She shows Paxos is one point on a broad spectrum of consensus approaches.
why: HN recommends it as an illuminating, approachable explanation of distributed consensus.

quote.text: Heidi Howard is incredible and her work on distributed consensus is illuminating.
